newsitem.title: USA: NCAA-GRAMBLING STATE UNIVERSITY PUT ON PROBATION FOR TWO YEARS.
newsitem.headline: NCAA-GRAMBLING STATE UNIVERSITY PUT ON PROBATION FOR TWO YEARS.

text.p: The NCAA placed Grambling State University on probation for two years Thursday for violations in recruiting, practice, academic eligibility and institutional control within the football and men's and women's basketball programmes.

Violations in football included impermissible recruiting contacts with two transfer players by an assistant coach in 1995. In addition, improper tryouts for prospective players and out-of-season practices were held from 1991-96.

The women's basketball violation occurred when a player practiced, played and received financial aid in 1993-94 and 1995-96 after her college admission test score was invalidated. In men's basketball, an ineligible player participated in five games in 1993.

In addition to the probation, the NCAA forfeited the women's basketball games in 1993-94 and 1995-96 in which an ineligible player participated, forfeited three men's basketball games won by Grambling in 1993-94 and imposed restrictions on recruiting procedures.
